Package com.jasonwjones.pbcs.client

Interface PbcsApplication

All Superinterfaces:
PbcsObject
All Known Implementing Classes:
PbcsApplicationImpl
public interface PbcsApplication extends PbcsObject
Models a PBCS application such as a Planning or an HFM application.
Author:
jasonwjones

    • getParent

      PbcsPlanningClient getParent()
      Description copied from interface: PbcsObject
      Returns the parent of this object, which may be another member, plan, application, client, or null if there is no logical parent. Interfaces that extend this one provide covariant return types that are more specific than a PbcsObject. For example, a plan will return its application as a parent.
      Specified by:
      getParent in interface PbcsObject
      Returns:
      the parent of this object

    • refreshCube

      PbcsJobStatus refreshCube()
      Despite the name, this seems to be a call to refresh the entire application. The documentation makes mention of 'the' planning cube, but I think in practice this is really the whole application.
      Returns:
      a job for tracking the refresh operation

    • refreshCube

      PbcsJobStatus refreshCube(String cubeRefreshName)
      Refreshes the cube with the refresh name. If the refresh name listed in your cube doesn't work, try using 'CubeRefresh'. During testing this seemed to work even when the refresh name was actually different.
      Parameters:
      cubeRefreshName - the CUBE_REFRESH name
      Returns:
      a job launch result

    • getMember

      PbcsMember getMember(String dimensionName, String memberName)
      Get information about a member. This is considered the canonical way to get a member from the PBCS/EPM Cloud member info API since it can make a straight call to the proper end point. The REST API endpoint has the dimension name in it, which necessitates knowing the dimension name ahead of time (unfortunately).

      You will almost always be better served using methods on the PbcsPlanType, such as the equivalent method PbcsPlanType.getMember(String, String).

      Parameters:
      dimensionName - the name of the dimension that the member is in
      memberName - the member name to look up
      Returns:
      the member

    • updateSubstitutionVariables

      void updateSubstitutionVariables(Collection<SubstitutionVariable> variables)
      Update a set of substitution variables. This does not replace all the variables in the application, it just updates the ones that have been specified in the collection (contrary to what the REST API docs seem to imply)

    • getPlanType

      PbcsPlanType getPlanType(String planTypeName)
      Gets the plan with the given name. This method is easy to use, but callers are strongly encourage to use the full getPlanType(PlanTypeConfiguration) method, which provides much more control over how the cube is instantiated and validated.
      Parameters:
      planTypeName - the plan name
      Returns:
      the plan/cube

    • getPlanType

      PbcsPlanType getPlanType(PbcsApplication.PlanTypeConfiguration configuration)
      Gets the plan/cube using the given configuration. This method mostly exists so that we don't have to keep changing signatures of methods as more options become available.
      Parameters:
      configuration - the configuration to get the plan with
      Returns:
